title: Elements 37-54: period 5
trouble: Rereading feels like knowing; it is not. Recall, then check.

blocks.html: Row five brings silver, tin and iodine, and some metals you may know from jewelry and electronics. Every element in this list is in period 5.

How to hold it: The same three chunks as row four: two s-block metals, ten transition metals, six p-block elements. Link each element to the one above it in row four (silver under copper, cadmium under zinc), since elements in a group act alike. Ag (argentum), Sn (stannum) and Sb (stibium) come from Latin, so give each a picture: a silver coin, a tin can, an old eye-makeup pot for stibium.
